segments.text: Tama po yun. Hindi lang po sa Iran po, pati yung sa Ukraine po, medyo tumaas po.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Yung mga wheat po na nanggagaling po sa Ukraine, tumaas din po pati yung mga presyo ng fertilizer. Apektado po ng gera na ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kung ganun po, Ginong Pangulo, hindi po ba dapat tayo mabahala kung katulad po ng sinabi kanina ni Sen. Amy Marcos,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: doon po sa talumpati ng ating matatawag na big brother,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: sa Sinabi po ni Pangulong Donald Trump, na malinaw po niyang sinabi, Ginong Pangulo, na ang Pilipinas ay aasa ng isang daang porsyento sa Estados Unidos sa usapin ng enerhiya at usapin din ng agrikultura.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: E ito pong dito po sa State of Hormuz.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Alam naman po natin, dito sa State of Hormuz, ano, dyan din po dumadaan ang mga langis at yung mga ginagamit po natin na fertilizer.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ang tanong ko lang po ba, hindi po po maapektuhan ang ating relasyon sa Iran?

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Dahil ang Iran po ay kaaway sa ngayon.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Eh, insya Allah, hindi na po talagang matuloy yung away nila, pero araw-araw po na pinagbabantaan ng Estados Unidos,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ang tanong ko po, tayo po ba hindi naiipit dito sa hidwaan nitong Iran at Amerika?

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: At lalo tayong malilibing sa usapin ng pagbagsak ng ating inflation kung tayo po ay nakadikit ng nakadikit dito sa Estados Unidos?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Maraming salamat po sa katanungan na yan, good senator.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pero, kailangan lang po nating balansihin ang ating relasyon sa pamagitan po ng Iran at sa pamagitan po ng United States.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kung ang inyo pong tinutukoy ay kung saan po tayo kukuha ng iba mga produkto na naiipit dahil nga po sa gera na yan,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: ay may ongoing na po at tumitingin na po tayo sa ibang bansa na maaaring po nating pagkunan ng mga petrolyo,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: ng iba pa, katulad ng mga fertilizers.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kaya, ang mahalagang bagay po, ginoong senador, ay yung patuloy na ikang diplomasyo at pakikipag-ugnayan at relasyon sa isang bansa.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Hindi naman po nararapat kasi na porkit kaaway nitong isang bansa, itong isang bansa,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: mamagitan po tayo doon at maaipit nga tayo.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kung what we're doing, the DFA is doing is, habang kaibigan po ito, patuloy din po ang ating relasyon,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: ang relasyon natin sa Amerika at sa iba pong bansa.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kaya nga po, ika nga, yung ating diplomatic lingo ay friends to all, enemies to none, ginoong senador.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Siguro po, ginoong Pangulo, kapag may mga ganitong paandar po ang Estados Unidos,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: dapat po siguro ay nagsasalita din po ang ating Department of Foreign Affairs para hindi naman po nagmumuka

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: na tayo'y namamalimus na lamang at sunod-sunuran na lamang dito.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kapag nagsasalita po ang, wala po akong galit sa Estados Unidos, kaibigan ko po ang ambasador nila

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: at ako po ay patuloy na namamagitan sa mga proyekto ng Amerika dito sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ang akin lamang po ay napakaseryoso po ng away ng Amerika at ng Iran.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ang dapat ay maging malinaw po na ang Pilipinas ay hindi po tayo kasama dyan.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Hindi po tayo, kasi kapag kasinabi po natin na apektado tayo sa gera sa Iran,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: parang linawin po natin sa taong bayan na hindi po tayo nakikialam dyan.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Tayo po ay economically apektado po tayo.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ang oil, ang mga fertilizer products, pero sa usapin po ng defense o kahit anong bagay,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: tayo po ay wala pong kinalaman dyan.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kaya sana po ang DFA, kapag may mga ganyan na paandar po ang Estados Unidos na lumalabas,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: na parang ang dating kasi parang payag na lang tayo.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kung ano yung sabihin ng presidente nila,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: sana po ay kung gaano kabilis din yung kanilang mga sinasabi,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: ganon din kabilis ang DFA na wala tayong kinalaman sa gulo doon.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Sana po ganon po din kabilis ang DFA na wala tayong kinalaman dyan.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: As a matter of fact, the DFA continue to...

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ikaw nga, ang ating bansa po remains neutral.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Nag-aaway man po ang mga kaibigan natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: As much as possible, ayaw po natin makialam.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Humihingi po ng komento ang isang bansa para tirayan ang isang bansa.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: I believe, ang DFA po ay ayaw po magbigay ng mga statements na ganon

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: because ayaw niya po magsalita man po tungkol sa isang bansa,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: baka masakta naman yung kanyang kaibigan, yung ating kaibigan na Iran.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Or magsalita man po ang DFA kontra sa Amerika,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: e baka masakta naman din po ang Iran o ang Amerika.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: So kailangan po na we really have to maintain ikanga yung relationship natin na neutral po tayo.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Maglalabas po ng statement ng DFA pero sa tamang panahon lamang po

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: because habang mainit pa po yung dalawa, ginong senador Padilla,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: ang mangyayari po kasi ay lalo lang po nating ikanga ay dinadagdagan

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: at pinapay pa yan yung apoy o usok sa dalawang bansa.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: So might as well ang decision po natin ay manahimik na lamang.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Dahil kapwa naman po ay kaibigan natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pero if we can as much as possible ikanga makausap po yung dalawa.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: At yun naman po talaga ang layon po natin na ayusin po nila yung pinaparating natin mensahe

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: as much as possible kung karoon po ng diyalogo,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: mas mabuti po at mas mainam para matapos na po itong gulo sa gitnang silangan.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ayan po ay ginoong Pangulo, naiintindihan po natin yung mga diplomatikong pamamaraan.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ang ibig lang po nating sabihin,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: DFA po kasi hinahangaan po natin yan sa usapin ng palestino.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Dahil yan po talaga ay tinayuan po yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: At lagi ko naman po sinasabi sa kalihim ng DFA,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: ang pasasalamat namin yung mga muslim,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: kapag nakikita po namin talaga na andyan ang DFA

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: at lumalaban po talaga para sa kamusliman.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Katulad po dyan sa palestinyan na talaga pong tinindigan ng Pilipinas yung ating two-state solution.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: At talaga naman po kahit sa United Nation,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: ay talaga naman pong tumatayo dyan ng ating kalihim at ipinaglalaban

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: na magkaroon talaga ng two-state solution sa palestino at dyan po sa Israel.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ang hinihingi lang po natin kasi, ganun din po sana sa Iran.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kasi sana po maging kung akin pong nanamnamin ang inyong sinabi na tayo'y parehas

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: pagdating dyan sa Amerika at sa Iran,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: eh ako na po magsasabi sa inyo parang hindi ko nararamdaman na parehas tayo.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kaya sana po gawin din po ninyo na pumarehas din naman tayo sa Iran.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kung baga kung ano yung sinasabi ng Estados Unidos na ganito ang Iran, na ganin ng Iran,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kapag kapwa namin Muslim ang lumalabas ng mga demonyo na

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: at lumalabas ng parang sinasabing sila na may kasalanan ng lahat,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ang hinihingi lang po namin, eh kung paano nyo ipinaglalaban ng palestino,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: eh ganun din nyo ipaglaban naman ng Iran.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Huwag naman nating labas na para namang hindi nating kaibigan yung Iran.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ito naman ho, eh matagal nang nakikipagkaibigan sa atin itong bansang ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Matagal na hong nag-aalay ng kanilang mga kamay na matulungan tayo.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: At ganun din naman po sa ibang mga bansa na nadadamay dyan.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Sana po ay maging parehas din po tayo, katulad po ng gulo ngayon,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: sa gitnang silangan, sa pagitan ng Huti, at nung mga bansang Arabo.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: ng paliwanag sa ating mga kababayan

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: milyon ang ating kababayang Pilipino dyan sa gitnang silangan.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ay hinihingi ko din po sana na sana sa ating DFA na masabi din sa ating mga kababayan

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Hindi naman po po pwede na ang lagi nalang lumalabas dito,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: magulo kaming mga Muslim, magulo itong mga Huti, magulo itong mga Arabo.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Eh sana po magkaroon po tayo ng malinaw na posisyon

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: na itong mga ganitong pangyayari, hindi ito dinulot ng mga Muslim.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ito'y dinulot ng mga tao, ng mga bansa, na sila ay nag-aagawan sa langis nila.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: At isang bagay na pakikialam, pakikialam ng mga dayuhan dun sa bansa nila.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: At huwag naman natin palabasin na, eh pambihira, wala akong naririnig eh.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: ang hinihiling ko, eh kung paano tayo magsalita ng pabor sa mga Palestino, eh ganun din po sana sa Iran.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Yun lamang naman po ang aking hinihiling, Ginuong Pangulo.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: To the gentlemen from Nueva Vizcaya,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: we acknowledge po yung inyong sentiments over our Muslim brothers.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pero lingit po sa kalaban ng ilan nung nakaroon po ng UN Security Council,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: nung nakaraang buwan ay kausap po ng kalihim ng Department of Foreign Affairs,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: ang Foreign Minister po ng Iran,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: to assure them na tayo po ay kaibigan pa rin po nila.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: At nagpasalamat po tayo, we extended our gratitude sa bansang Iran

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: for helping out ang overseas Filipino workers natin,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: lalo na po yung mga seafarers natin na hindi po binobomba, hindi po inaatake ng drones ng Iran,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: And ngayon pong December po ay patutungo po ang Secretary ng DFA sa Oman at Qatar

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: para kausapin din po to make assurance po na tayo po ay patuloy po

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: na susuporta sa mga bansang nasa gitna silangan, particular na po ang Iran.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: It's just that hindi po kasi maaaring basta lang po tayo ikang pumasok sa isang away ng magkaibigan,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: so kailangan po nating alamin po muna at kailan po tayo papasok upang matapos

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: at pagkausapin ang dalawang grupo na para matigil na po.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Dahil pare-pareho lang naman sila po, nagkakasakitan.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ang Iran po nasasaktan, marami po mga damages.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ganon din po naman ang Estados Unidos, yung kanyang mga sundalo at yung mga kaibigan na bansa

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: kung nasaan po yung mga base ng Amerika ay nadadamay na rin po.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kaya nga, as much as possible,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: we try to remain neutral at gusto po natin kausapin yung ating mga kaibigan.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: It's just the timing lamang po, good gentleman from Nueva Vizcaya,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: yung panahon po para tayo po ay pumasok.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Napakagandang balita po, ginong Pangulo, na marinig na magbibigay na po ng statement

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: ang ating DFA na kaibigan natin ng Iran.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: At hindi po tayo nakikisama sa gulo nila ng Estados Unidos.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: At yan po ay pinapangako ko na palalawigin ko po yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kapag ginawa niyo yung statement po na yan,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: ay pamamalita ko po yan sa mga kamusliman na wala po tayong kaaway dito.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ang Pilipinas ay walang pinapanigan sa away na yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ngayon naman po, bilang kasunod po ng aking pagtatanong,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: ito naman po ay wala naman pong kinalaman sa kamusliman.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ito naman po ay patungkol naman po dahil napag-usapan po natin

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: yung mga base militar ng mga Estados Unidos na inaatake.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Sa gitnang silangan, dahil sa gera nila, dahil sa away nila ng Iran,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: dito po ba sa Pilipinas, hindi po ba tayo dapat mangamba?

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Na baka isang araw ay may mga kaaway itong Estados Unidos,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: di ba po tayo madadamay dyan?

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ano po ba ang posisyon ng DFA dyan?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ang EDCA po, ang Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: yung mga bases po, actually we don't call them bases,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ito po ay training areas lamang po.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: At pangalawa, dito po magja-jump off kung kinakailangan po

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: yung mga relief operations, training din po and partnership

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: para sa mga lugar kung sa kasakali po magkaroon ng unos o ikang dilubyo,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: mas madali po kasing ikang i-store yung kanilang mga kagamitan,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: yung kanilang mga relief, pati relief operations,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: kung sa kasakali man po ay sapiti ng Pilipinas na naman isang malaking dilubyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Opo, malinaw po dyan na ginawang Pangulo,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: iyaan po ang paliwanag ng Estados Unidos.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Pero, totoo po ba na ang mga Pilipino ay hindi naman nakakapasok dyan sa EDCA sites?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Hindi pa po kasi tapos siyang construction po,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: ang pagkakaalam po namin ng EDCA sites.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ito nga po ay training exercise lang.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: May mga nag-maintain naman po ng mga Pilipino dyan,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: pero hindi naman po kasi kasi po yan ay isang facility po yan,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Sa Estados Unidos, kati pati po ng Armed Forces of the Philippines,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: ginagawa pong training areas po nila yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: So, hindi po basta-basta pinapapasok ang sibilyan sa mga ikang facilities niyan.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: kung ang DFA po ba meron silang karapatan na pumasok dyan at mag-check up?

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Dahil malinaw naman po sa ating saligang batas na ipinagbabawal

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: ang mga nuclear arms dito sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Meron po ba silang access dyan?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Maraming salamat po sa katanungan na yan, good gentleman.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ang Presidential Commission of Visiting Forces po ang nag-i-inspect po niyan.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Bagay ito po ay sa ilalim po ng DFA at pupondohan po natin ngayong 2027

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: para masiguro po na na-inspeksyon yung mga lugar na yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kasama po sa agreement po na yan na bawal po mag-imbak ng mga ikang malalaking armas po dyan

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: dahil yan po ay training exercise.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: At ikang training exercise po hindi lang para sa gera kundi training exercise para sa ikang emergency response.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ibig pong sabihin, ginawang Pangulo, na mapagkakatiwalaan po natin na tunay na wala tayong makikita ang mga armas dyan.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ongoing po ang inspeksyon po ng Presidential Commission and Visiting Forces Agreement.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pero wala po, nasa agreement po yan na hindi po sila pwede mag-imbak o mag-iwan po ng mga kagamitan.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Alam ko po yung inyong ibig pong sabihin na baka maging target po tayo ng ating mga kalaban.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pero so far po, wala naman po nakikita yung ahensya po na Visiting Forces Commission po natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: At kasama po sa kasunduan niya na hindi po mag-iiwan dyan ng mga gamit, ng mga aeroplano, mga helicopter, kung anong pa man po na armas.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Yan po ay purely training center lamang po.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Opo, iyon po ay maiku-commit ng DFA?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo

segments.text: Any objection? Hearing none, consideration of the budget of the Civil Service Commission is in order. Senator Erwin Tulfo, Chairman, is recognized.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. President. Thank you, Majority Floor Leader. To the officials and members of the Civil Service Commission, led by its Chairperson, Attorney Marilyn Baruwayap, and to the Career Executive Service Board,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: led by Chairperson Urduja Alvarado, a pleasant good afternoon to everyone. As the Vice Chairperson of the Subcommittee H of the Committee on Finance, I am pleased to present the proposed budgets of two vital institutions that play an indispensable role in our government's pursuit of an efficient, professional, responsive public service. For Fiscal Year 2027, the proposed total new appropriations of the Civil Service Commission stand at 3.1 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: This is 1 billion lower than its proposed budget under the National Expenditure Program, but higher than the 2.91 billion allocation under the General Appropriations Bill. The additional funding request by the CSC and approved by your subcommittee will be used to augment CSC Central Office MOOE, as well as to provide additional funding for its ICT requirements. Meanwhile, the proposed total new appropriations for the Career or of the Career Executive Service Board for Fiscal Year 2027 amount to 200.8 million pesos,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: which is higher than the amounts provided under both the NEP and the GAB. Your subcommittee likewise approved the CESB's additional budget request of 62 million pesos, which will be used to augment its MOOE and capital outlay requirements. These allocations represent our continuing commitment to strengthening the institutions that develop, nurture,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: and uphold the quality of our public servants.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Sa madaling sabi, ang pamumuhunan natin sa dalawang institusyon na ito ay pamumuhunan din sa ating mga lingkod bayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: At kung mas mahusay ang ating mga lingkod bayan, mas mahusay din po ang serbisyong may ibibigay natin sa ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: With these points in mind, I respectfully submit for the body's consideration to propose new appropriations for Fiscal Year 2027 of the Civil Service Commission and the Career Service Executive Board.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: And do we need to amend the law?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: What they're using now is the 2025 SAL-N.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: So as of 2026, there is a new format?

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: I'm not going to, because the majority leader is asking me why do I have a lot of briefers here.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: I am not going to use all of this, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: I will only focus on one, two issues because we are in the midst of modernization program ng civil service.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: So I just have one, two issues that I'd like to raise.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And this is all friendly queries.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: In order for us to help the agency, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: So first question ko lang, distinguished colleague, Mr. President, yung status po nitong Philippine Civil Service Modernization Project.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And ang CSC po ba will meet its 2027 targets for the Human Resource Management Information System and Payroll System?

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: At gusto lang natin ma-put on record kasi po ang PCSMP is a 3.878 billion project led by civil service.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And of course, ang DBM ay co-executing agency financed by US, I mean World Bank Loan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Financed po ito ng World Bank Loan na nagkakalagang $67.34 million.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Magkaroon ng update po dito sana, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: So it can be in the records.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Thank you, the distinguished gentleman from Bulacan.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And we'll meet our target po, this 2027 target.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Di ba ginagawa nyo na po ito?

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And how will civil service commission protect the personnel?

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And how will it protect the personal data of more than 2.25 million government workers

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And I'd like to say that it's a commendable effort, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: We should have done this earlier but at least we're doing it now.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: According to the chairman, Mr. President,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: there's a security feature of the data management system.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kaya safe po yung mga ikang detalye ng mga government.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Just for the record lang po.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: if we can be more proactive

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: we hope that we can do better.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: that we'll have to pass here

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: in the State of the Nation

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: ako, may bill pa rin po

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Siguro yung last na lang po

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: 667 cases, and it had promulgated 4,897 by mid-year.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Now, of the 5,029 aging cases in the 2026 inventory,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: ang civil service targets is 1,810 for promulgation

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: May we understand and be clarified on this particular target

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ongoing naman na po, Mr. President,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: ang promulgation ng mga cases nila.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Tuloy-tuloy po yan, pero bumaba nga po yung pending nilang nila

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Mr. President, Distinguished Gentleman from Bulacan.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pero may mga promulgation pa po silang ginagawa.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And this happened because of what?

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Kasi baka mamaya, budget, mayroon bang kinalaman?

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Para makatulong po tayo, if ever?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: What the reducing the age of pending cases sa priority,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: pero binago daw po nila yung system ng paghandal ng cases.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pero may mga nadinagdag po sila na process.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kaya po medyo, medyo, hindi ka agad na [unclear]

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: ang pag-resolve ng mga cases, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Siguro po, ang hilingin ko lang po, baka pwedeng makakuha nung report po na yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: So we can find out kung paano rin tayong makakatulong.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Yun lang naman po yung nais kong i-clarify para masiguro po natin

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: na nakakatulong din po kami bilang policy makers sa ating civil service.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: We have been very supportive of the commission

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: and the records from this August Chamber would bail me out.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Especially now that the head of civil service is our good friend

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: and our, how do we call it, the majority leader.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And the ever-reliable Secretary General of the House of Reps

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: when we were all growing up.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Benjamin of the House pa po ako noon.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Ngayon, puro aging na ho kami ni majority leader.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: But again, maraming salamat po and we continue to put on record

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: our biggest support to the commission.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Gusto lang po nila idagdag, Mr. President, that they will submit yung mga requests po ninyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. President, or our Deputy Majority Floor Leader.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Mr. President, there are no longer any members who wish to interpolate the measure.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: I move that the budget of the Civil Service Commission,

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Civil Service and the Career Executive Service Board be deemed submitted.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Hearing none, the budget of the Civil Service Commission is hereby deemed submitted.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: We ask for a minute suspension, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Mr. President, before we take up the other department, we'd like to recognize our distinguished colleague,

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Secretary of Education, Senator, Secretary, Sani Angara.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: We welcome our colleague and fraternal brother, Senator, now Secretary, Sani Angara.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: And we're just keeping his seat warm for him.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: God willing, he will be back.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Mr. President, I move that we take up the budget of the Presidential Communications Office.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: I move that we take up the budget of the Presidential Communications Office.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: These are the, well, there are several agencies.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: There are attached agencies to the PCO.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: May I recognize the sponsor, Senator Erwin Tulfo, Mr. President?

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Hearing no objection, the budget of the PCO and the attached agencies is hereby considered and in order.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: And Senator Erwin Tulfo is recognized.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: I rise to sponsor the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: and its attached agencies and corporations.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: As a journalist myself, I firmly believe

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: that effective communication is an essential part of good governance.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: In an era where information spreads rapidly

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: and where misinformation, disinformation, and fake news continue to pose serious challenges,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: the PCO plays a vital role.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: In ensuring that our people are timely, accurately, and properly informed of government programs

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: and initiatives that directly affect their daily lives.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: For fiscal year 2027, the Senate Committee on Finance recommends a total budget of

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: 3,423,128,000 in new appropriations for the PCO and its attached agencies and corporation.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: The proposed budget also includes budgetary support for the following attached corporations.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: The proposed appropriation represents a 26.10% increase from the Fiscal Year 2026 General Appropriations Act.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: This increase is intended to strengthen government communication services and ensure public access to accurate, timely, and reliable information.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: For transparency, House Bill No. 10858 introduced additional appropriations.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Of approximately 673 million, including an additional 25 million for the PCO proper, 12 million for the Philippine Information Agency, 35.986 million for IBC, and 600 million for the operations of PTV.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: The Senate Committee on Finance retained these allocations and recommended an additional 223.943 million for IBC-13.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Primarily to support the network's maintenance and operating expenses pending its privatization.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: With these considerations, Mr. President, I respectfully submit the proposed Fiscal Year 2027 budget of the Presidential Communications Office and its attached agencies and corporations for the consideration and approval of this August Chamber.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: I'm now ready to answer questions from our distinguished colleagues.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Yes, may we recognize Senator, of course, our Deputy Majority Floor Leader, Senator Joel Villanueva.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. President, Distinguished Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Just to put on record, Mr. Presiding Officer, it feels like 18th Congress,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: you sitting there and the Majority Leader here with the seatmates in the plenary session.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Mr. President, just to put on record, my full support to the budget of PCO

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: and I'm more than happy to see beside our colleague, Senator Erwin Tulfo,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: the chairperson of PCO, no other than my brother, Senator Lino Cayetano,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: who is also the classmate of the late Johnny Villanueva, my sister.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: So I'm just happy to see him there.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: He's celebrating today, your sister's birthday, right?

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Yeah, and my sister's celebrating her birthday today in heaven.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And I'm just happy to see a lot of good friends.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Of course, the legend, Jim Paul is here.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Some senators are asking your age.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: But I told them that it should not be part of the deliberation today.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Just want to put that on record, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And we hope that PCO would do better.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Now, and we know that they will because there are some communication problems

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: that we have encountered in the past.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: I feel that it's important that, for instance, the only administration that had a employment plan, master plan, is this administration.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: This is the very first administration that take the cudgels of coming up with an employment plan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And it's very important to note that it's working very well.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And that's why yesterday, during the deliberation of the budget for the general principles and the budget of our economic managers,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: when one of the secretaries mentioned that there was zero increase in employment in the manufacturing sector,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: I immediately took the floor and said that is not true because meron namang increase.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Ang problem lang is hindi ganun kalaki yung increase to cover the increase in the unemployment.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: So, again, that's a communication problem that we still are looking into that needs a lot of improvement.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And, again, I am happy to see Secretary Lino Cayetano at the top of this department.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Ginong Paul, and again, I give my sincerest thanks and gratitude to our

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Majority Leader and our Senate President. Thank you. Thank you very much.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: I'm glad you mentioned that aside from Secretary Cayetano, Lino Cayetano, we also have Jimmy here, Jimmy Policarpio.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: And the father of Senator Sonny Angara, Senator Ed Angara and myself,

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: And the chief of staff was Jimmy Policarpio.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: I think he was about 16 years old during that time.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Mr. Presiding Officer, would you know his age?

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Yes, they keep asking how old he is.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: I think we will be ready to give him his senior card soon.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: He's about 58 years old, I think.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: We'd like to recognize our distinguished colleague, Senator Robin Hood Padilla, to ask a question.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Senator Robin Hood Padilla is recognized.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Ginong Pangulo, at sa ating pinunong mayorya.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kung mamarapatid po ng ating Ginong sponsor na makapagtanong lang po tayo ng ilang maimportanting katanungan.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Opo, malagot po namin sasagutin ang mga katanungan po ng ating kasamahan.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: May ko pong batiin ang isang kilalang director ng Pilikulang Pilipino at Telebisyon,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ako po ay ang chairman po ng public information dito sa Senate.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: At matagal ko na pong isinusulong ang freedom of information.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: At madalas ko po hingin sa dating kalihim ng PICO na tulungan ako para maipasa po ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: At madalas po ang itinuturo niya ay ang kamara, ang mga kasama po natin sa Congress,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ang malaking kapulungan na hindi pa po nagbibigay ng kanilang version.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: At ngayon po na may version na sila, nandun na po kami sa BICAM.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ang malungkot lamang po, hindi pa po sila nagbibigay ng kanilang membro.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: At alam ko naman po na may kapangyarihan ng PICO upang alam ko naman po na meron kayong representante doon.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Sa Congress, sa kamara, na sana po ay pumasa na ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Sana po, ito po ay kasama po natin dito, ang inyong sponsor, si Senator Erwin Tulfo, kasama po sa nagsusulong nitong FOI.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Napakahalaga po nito, mahal naming kalihim, sapagkat dito po talaga malalaman na natin kung sino po talaga yung mga

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kung ano yung mga ay tinatago nila.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Dahil ito nga po ay freedom of information.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Sana po, mahal naming kalihim ay bilang ako po ay kasama ninyo sa pelikula ng matagal, sa industriya natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Hinihingi ko po ang tulong po ninyo na mapwersa.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Pwersahin na po ninyo sana yung nandyan sa kamara na mag-BICAM na po kami.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: At kung ano man po yung version ninyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ay mapag-consolidate po natin at maipasa po natin itong batas na ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Una po sa lahat, nagpapasalamat po ang ating kalihim si Secretary Cayetano,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: sa 10 na kanya mga kasamahan, sa inyong adbukasya at ikanga sa patuloy na pagsulong po ng Freedom of Information Bill.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Tulad niyo po, tulad ko po, si Secretary Cayetano po ay nagtapos din sa communications at sa media rin po.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kaya po, full support po, di lang po siya kundi ang buong ahensya.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Yung sinasabi po ninyo kakausapin po, agad-agad po ay hahanap po siya ng koneksyon,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: kakausapin po ang miembro ng mababang kapulungan upang makapag-umpisa na po na magkaroon po kayo ng BICAM.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Apo, maraming salamat po, Ginong Pangulo.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Sapagkat ito po ay alam niyo po, itong kasaysayan ng bill na ito,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: lagi po itong pumapasa sa Senado,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: lagi po itong pumapasa sa Senado,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: nakaharang po ito lagi sa ano, nata-traffic po.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Inihiling po natin sana, insya Allah ay pumasa na po ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: May may dadagdag lang po, Ginong Senador, ang ating pong kalihim na siya po,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: pagkatapos po nito ay dadalo sa inyong opisina para makipag-augnayan at kumonsulta sa inyo,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: hinggil po dito sa inyong sinusulong po na Freedom of Information Bill

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: at kung ano pa ang maaaring maitulong po.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Sa pangalawang tanong na lang po,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: meron pong ulat po kasi na nakarating po sa aming tanggapan, Ginong Pangulo,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: na yun daw pong Presidential Communication Office ay binura daw po ang lahat ng material

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: ng may kinalaman kay Pangulong Rodrigo Roa Duterte.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: ay kaagad po na inatasaan ng kalihim ang Philippine Information Agency upang i-retrieve ang lahat ng mga file videos

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: documentation patungkol po sa dating Pangulong Duterte at sa kanyang administrasyon.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Wala pong binura at patuloy po na ni-re-retrieve ngayon ang ikang lahat ng mga contents,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: lahat po ng mga video interviews patungkol po sa dating Pangulong.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ni-re-retrieve. So nagkaroon po talaga ng pagbura?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Bago po kasi itong administrasyon na ito na down po yung mga websites.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pero kaya nga po ngayon ay nare-recover na po lahat po ngayon.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Hindi po sinasadya, Ginong Pangulo, at hindi po papayag ang PCOO

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo

segments.text: Because as far as the Senate is concerned,

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: we do not have a version yet.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: So, um, am I to take it that the Department of Tourism

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: is not in favor of this, uh, proposal?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: uh, it has already passed in, uh, Congress.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Committee level only, but not, uh...

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: The third and final reading, uh, last March of 2026.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: The Senate, uh, the measure remains pending here

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: in the Senate, uh, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Was the Department of Tourism heard

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: in the hearings that were conducted in the House?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Tiaza was, uh, invited several times, uh,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Mr. President, uh, uh, uh, former Senate President.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Um, however, uh, the, the reasons were not clearly given to them.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Why the abolition of the travel tax?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: This despite of, uh, their explanation, uh, Mr. President,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: na malaki po ang mawawala sa ikang, sa, sa Department of Tourism.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: At marami po mga apektohan, katulad po,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: nitong, uh, scholars po natin sa, uh, CHED.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: And then yung mga infrastructure projects,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: rehabilitation of infrastructure, uh, tourism, uh, areas.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Yet, despite all these explanations, uh, Mr. President,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: patuloy po at pumasa po ito sa, sa committee level ng Congress.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Who is the chairman of the Committee on Tourism here in the Senate, Mr. President?

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: The chairman of the, uh, Committee on Tourism is Senator Marco Leta, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: So, we would not know if, uh, the House version or the House bill has already been forwarded to the Senate Committee.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: I believe this is, uh, under the...

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Under the Committee on Ways and Means, uh...

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Even in the House of Representatives, basically?

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Yes, this is a taxation measure.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, um, all taxation measures emanate from the House.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And I believe it's already referred in the Committee on Ways and Means here in the Senate.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: And our Ways and Means is...

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Uh, if I may add, Mr. President, um, uh,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: my, uh, distinguished, uh, colleague, uh,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: the Department of Tourism is hoping that the Senate

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: may reconsider the transition period requested by Tiaza at this point.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: That there'll be a transition period.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: May I know the plans of the Department on boosting domestic tourism

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: given that, uh, traveling to our neighboring countries,

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: now, is cheaper than traveling to tourist destinations in the Philippines?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: the DDOT is coordinating right now with 18 regional offices,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: uh, which work closely with LGUs and provide technical assistance

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: in developing and improving local tourism destinations.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: strengthen their airport capacity and international connectivity.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: You have Coron, maximize the existing airport to support

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: increased island, marine, and dive tourism.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Build an existing airport and further develop public-private partnership.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Siquijor in the Visayas, strengthen airport connectivity.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: uh, uh, the efforts are being done by, uh,

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Well, aside from the issue of transportation,

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: uh, Your Honor, uh, Mr. President,

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: are we not pricing our domestic tourists

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: out of, uh, vacationing in our country?

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: By a few months ago, I, I read some articles,

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: and that's why I bring this up.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: There was an article released stating that a

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: A grab car in Vietnam, uh,

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: costs around 80 pesos to get around

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: While again, in Panglao Bohol, it costs, uh,

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: 100 to 250 pesos for a tricycle ride around Panglao itself.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Um, this, um, uh, this was, uh,

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: I, I, I've read this somewhere in the, in the newspapers.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: It does seem that we're pricing our domestic tourists

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: out of exploring our beautiful country.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: What can we, what can the Department of Tourism do about this?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: over tourism in Bohol right now,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: is coordinating with the LGU to monitor prices of goods.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: To complement this, the Panglao price monitoring team

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: During the meeting of the Presidential Assistant for Visayas, it was decided the Department of Trade and Industry would be responsible for the regulation and monitoring of goods services.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: The DOT, however, commenced to refer reported incidents of overpricing to DTI-7 for proper handling.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: In short, Mr. President, dapat po kasama po ang ibang mga ahensya na tumutulong sa Department of Tourism to monitor, not only po other agencies like DTI.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: But also the local government units para ma-monitor.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Because DOT doesn't have enough ikang personal to monitor all these prices in the market, yung fare ng mga local transportation.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: There has to be help from other agencies as well, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Thank you for that. But sometime ago, I distinctly remember.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: We should give more concentration to the Department itself.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: I believe that the number one dollar earner of the Philippines should be tourism.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: The Department of Tourism agrees with the former Senate President, definitely.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pero there's a lot of factors po kasi daw.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: The problem with our low tourism.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: One of those, even local tourism, Mr. President, the problem is yung pong transportation.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: If you go to small islands in the Visayas and in Luzon, before reaching that area, you have to travel to Clark, Pampanga.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: The problem kasi it was already transferred.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pag naka-turbo prop yung aeroplano, because the airport in the destination that you're going small,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Turbo props are now flying out from Clark and not anymore in Naia.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: So yung mga tao na instead of going to, for example, ng Siquijor, because turbo prop po yung twin engine na LEC or Coron, Palawan,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: medyo tinatamad na, Mr. President, na pumunta pa sa Clark para makapunta lang sa Coron,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: The Department of Tourism noticed this.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Noong magkaroon po ng paglilipat ng ika nga naka-turbo prop na aeroplano,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: maliliit na airplanes that they use para po sa mga island na mga destinations natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: So people, Mr. President, are tired.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: So instead of going to local destinations, halos pareho lang naman ang presyo,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: they'd rather go overseas, they'd rather go to Thailand to go there.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Or Vietnam, which is more cheaper.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: So yun po ang nagiging problem.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kaya nga po, we have already, in one of the hearings, I've already asked the DOTR to look into this.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kasi tinatamad po yung mga kababayan natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Instead of going to Clark, mapapatagal po ang biyahe nila,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: e pupunta na lang po sa ibang bansa at mas mura pa.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Another issue, Mr. President, is yung cost po ng fair ng aeroplano.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: sinasagot na po kasi ng pasahero dahil hindi po napupuno.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Like if you're going, kaya nga po may mga areas tayo dito sa Pilipinas,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: like in my Maropa, in my area, in my region,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: may mga flights po dati dyan sa Marinduque,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: may mga flights po dati dyan sa Rumblon,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: naputol na po because it's so expensive,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Parang pinagbabayad po yung isang pasahero, round trip ka agad.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: ng aeroplano, parang may sakay na pasahero.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: So the fees are so exorbitant, masyadong malaki.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kaya this turns off yung mga would-be local tourists in several local destinations, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: So, well, then we expect the department to reason to find solutions

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: and suggest solutions to the executive department when it comes to these issues, hopefully.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Mr. President, actually, there's an ongoing dialogue with the Department of Tourism

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: and the Department of Transportation regarding this matter.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pero when it comes po dun sa airline, kailangan din po isama ang NMIC

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: because sila po yung may control, sila po yung may instruction.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Naalisin na po yung mga turboprop airplanes going to small island tourist destination.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Inilipat na po nila sa Clark.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: People are getting tired traveling to Clark.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: For another hour, then when they come home, they have to travel again another hour going back to Metro Manila.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kaya po doon nakita na may problema ho dito.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Because yung travel time, it's so expensive.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: But there is a coordination between the DOT and the DOTR.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Alright. We will look forward to that.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: One of the best ways to teach history and share the...

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: The beautiful culture of the Philippines is through tourism.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Would you have any plans to put up more museums and other interactive displays

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: in our top tourism destinations for this purpose?

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: And would it be included in your budget for 2027?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: If the president is asking if there's a plan to set up more museums,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: unfortunately, there is none right now, Mr. President, because of budget constraints.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pero what DOT is doing is upgrading training programs.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: For tour guides, another thing, cultural heritage destinations, pinapalakas po yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Like in archaeological sites, museums, world heritage, treasuries, cultural properties, etc.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Then creative tourism, new generation tourism,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: that places an emphasis on engaging tourists with local culture, arts, and heritage, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: I hope the department tries to develop the idea.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Well, to include also, Mr. President, we still have the Nayang Pilipino right now.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Total open space and museum visitors was listed at 11,165 as of October 2026, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: For the National Parks Development Committee,

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: it's very obvious that there are lesser public parks in the metros for children to play

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: and for families to just lounge around for free.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: In fact, we have more malls than parks.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Do we have plans of acquiring lots and creating free parks and conducive open spaces?

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Whether Metro Manila or other parts of the country,

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: may be harnessed to support this move by the department.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: As much as they would love to focus on developing more parks, Mr. President,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: unfortunately, the funding gaps for park development is down to 65 million,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: or they needed 65 million to complete the Japanese Garden Redevelopment Landscape Utilities.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: For fiscal year 2027 budget, reductions may affect priority programs,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pero in the NEP of 2027, it's down to 286.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Well, we will try, the Senate will try to maintain that at 286.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: And also, can't you try to...

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: can't the department try to coordinate with local government units?

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Because the LGUs may have a lot of ideas.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Maybe by coordinating with them, helping the tourism department,

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: maybe there are things like that.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Just bringing up the idea, Your Honor, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Unfortunately, according to the DOT, Mr. President,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: there is no funding yet for such activity or programs.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: So, it's very hard for them to look for, to develop parks in different parts of our country.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Well, as I said, baka pwedeng in coordination with some LGUs na maluluwag pa.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Anyway, again, I throw the idea to the department for their consideration.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: I heard you earlier mention figures about international tourists.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: In 2015, and this is based on the old records that I have now, so correct me if I'm wrong,

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: we had roughly 5.3 million international tourists.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: For reference, Vietnam had around 7.9 million.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: So now, in 2025, 10 years after, we have 6.8 million.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: But Vietnam has now 21.2 million international tourists.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: My question is, why in the past decade, our tourism generally could be said as static?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: The explanation of the Department of Tourism, the reason why our country is lagging behind in tourist arrivals,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: our neighbors, Thailand, Malaysia, and Vietnam, have been investing big amounts for tourism.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: is only like about one-fourth of how much they spend.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: I'll give you some figures, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: For example, the budget of Thailand for tourism in 2024 is $167.9 million.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: So, ang arrival po, makikita din, that will translate.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: The Thailand expenditure on the tourism brought them around 35.55 million tourists in 2024.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: And because of our funding, we only got 5.95 million tourists, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: The problem really, it's a fact, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: So, that's where we're having problems right now.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: if you notice other countries like Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: you will see them in international news.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: They advertise major newspapers, New York Times, etc., Singapore's Three Times.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Unfortunately, because of a limited budget, we cannot afford.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: We did that a couple of years ago in the buses of England,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: but that's not enough to boost, to advertise our tourism in the Philippines, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Well, thank you for your answers.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: And thank you to the department.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: But, well, I hope we could get back to the drawing board.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: And study the possibilities of these suggestions that might be able to develop.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Another thing, Mr. President, is like,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: I myself would suggest to the DOT to stick with one branding campaign.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Because we noticed the change of administration.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Before, it's like, now it's love the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Before, it was like, wow, Philippines during the time of former Senator Gordon.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: And then, it's more fun in the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Unlike Malaysia, Mr. President, if you notice in the commercials,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: they've been using this for the past 20 years.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: nakailang palit na ho tayo for the past 20 years.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: So, I guess we have to stick to that brand.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: And then, let's stick with love the Philippines

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: so that it will stick to the minds of the viewers and listeners

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: listening to the advertisements of the DOT.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Just to end my interpellation, Your Honor,

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: I have a suggestion that you should study that.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Tutal, meron tayong mga pinag-usapan na ganyan.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Many years ago, during the younger days of myself and Senator Aimee Marcos,

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Diba? It was not that popular.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: You know what the Department of Tourism of Hawaii did?

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: They created a TV show entitled Hawaii Five-O.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: All of a sudden, Hawaii was in the limelight all over the world.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: And perhaps the Department of Tourism can study something like that for, let's say, Boracay or somewhere up north.

segments.speaker: Senator Vicente C. Sotto III
segments.text: Thank you very much, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: We will take note on that.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Thank you to our former Senate President for his interventions.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Yes, Mr. President, if I may, just to assist the Department of Tourism,

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: if I may just, not propound questions, but just a few manifestations on the issue.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Mr. President, thank you for giving me some time.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
