segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: A big chunk of the budget to our education sector.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Ginong Pangulo. Maraming salamat sa ating chairperson, Sen. Bam.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And again, we congratulate DepEd family for having the best DepEd Secretary in the history of this nation

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: through Secretary Sani Angara. Maraming salamat, Ginong Pangulo.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Mr. President, if I may add,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Binawi lang ni Sen. Julian sa dulo, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But the truth is, Mr. President,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: a lot of us have shared our frustrations with this budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And I have spoken to the Senate President multiple times to share my frustration

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: with the fiscal space provided for this important agency.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: EDCOM 2, of course, led by Sen. Julian and myself.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Of course, ED Carol is here.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We've also shared our frustrations with the cuts in education that we've seen.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Alam naman ito ng mga kasalanan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We have proposed much bigger budgets.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Sen. Joel proposed a much bigger budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I proposed a much bigger budget only to be met with an answer that we didn't like,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: which is that the fiscal space is very limited, which we understand.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Pero, Mr. President, naniniwala po ako na before the period of amendments,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: kaya pa po natin itong itaas.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We can still push this further.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Specifically, ang pinuntiri ako na po is the feeding process.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We have ratified that law yesterday and I think it is incumbent upon us to feed the Grade 2.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, diyan pa lang po ako pinag-uusapan ng feeding program bilang isa sa pinakamabisang solusyon

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: sa mga problema natin sa edukasyon.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I think Secretary, former Senator Sunny, student leader pa rin siya, ito na yung pinag-uusapan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Finally, we have the law to make this happen.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Pero, nabitin po tayo ng Grade 2.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: In fact, the law is until Grade 3.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And we just agreed to a progressive implementation.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: This school year, we're already feeding universally, kinder and Grade 1.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Sana naman next year, kasama na rin yung Grade 2.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And then the year after that, Grade 3, which will be the full implementation of the law.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: That's 6.2 billion. That's less than 0.8% of the national budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I'm sure mahanap po natin yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And Senators Pangilinan, Lacson, I know members of the minority also want to support.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Marami po sa atin pwede magtulungan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Now, if I had a number 2 na kailangan pong pondohan, it's really the aral program.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Because we know that it can work.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We've been talking about our learning gap for so many months.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Even before I came here, pinag-uusapan na po ito ng EDCOM 2.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And the main solution to the learning gap is really a remediation program.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Now, sa totoo lang, Mr. President, nakikita natin may mga unutilized na banggit ni Senator Marcos na 13% lang yung discharge.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Maybe that's why this was not budgeted by DBM.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But if we can increase this, I would support that, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And in fact, I'm hoping, much like last year where we all talked about a historic budget for education,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I hope that, Mr. President, we can still move this budget up.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And Senator Joel and I were talking yesterday and today.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: It's quite interesting that we're defending a budget which we want to increase.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Which we will move to increase, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But hopefully, Mr. President, with our colleagues here and eventually with our colleagues in Congress,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: mahanapan po natin ang pondo, dagdag na pondo ang edukasyon.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kung ako po ang tatanungin, I would choose to fund first our feeding program.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kasi yun po, Mr. President, hindi po yan dadaan sa mga ahensya.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Hindi po siya dadaan sa DPWH.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Hindi po yan dadaan kina mayor.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Yan po, directly mapupunta sa mga bata.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And that's, again, the price of this, Mr. President, is 6.3 billion.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: The National Children's Nutrition Program is a top priority of this government.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Nabanggit rin po ito ni Sen. Joel kahapon.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Gumagawa tayo ng mga batas, kailangan natin pondohan yung mga reformang ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So let's fund this law, let's increase the budget of education.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: At yung nabanggit kanina ni Sen. Aimee na pasangawang 4%, 4.02,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: sana naman makiat natin siya further.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We can push it further, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I know many of our colleagues can come together and fund education even better than what we have now.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So with that, let me thank my chairman.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: By the way, ang una pong topic kasi, SNED, nakalimutan kong banggitin.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We have already requested EDCOM to do a more serious and a deeper study on our SNED.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Because Mr. President, yung developmental pediatrician, kahit mapondohan po natin yan, kulang talaga sa Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Even if we had the funding, which we don't, there's not enough.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So we want to have a deeper understanding of how we can support

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: and care for our special needs children even better.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Which I know, Mr. President, the good chairman of higher education will also be supportive on this.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So let me thank everyone. Maraming salamat.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But if we're not, we have, of course, time for more questions, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Just a quick reaction, Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Last year, ang ating allocation is about 1.3 trillion pesos.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Last year, kasi nagkaroon tayo ng opportunity because of the flood control issue.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Dahil nung tinanggal yung flood control, nagkaroon tayo ng space na ilinagay natin sa classroom,

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: sa aral program, sa feeding program, additional teachers, textbooks.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: At nagpapasalamat po ako kay Secretary Angara dahil yung pondo na yun ay nagamit,

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, but this time around, dahil nag-regular programming ang DPWH,

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero hindi pa naman tapos, Senator Bam, yung budget process.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: At I share your sentiment na kailangan ay buhusan natin ng pondo ang sektor ng edukasyon,

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: lalo na kung nandito si Secretary Angara, isang education champion at former EDCOM,

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Nasa magandang kamay ang Department of Education.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, we'll work with you on that one.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: At least makahanap pa tayo ng additional funds for the feeding program and aral program.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Since anyway, 846 na rin and mas masarap makipag-usap kapag gabing-gabi na, di ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Wala naman tayong hinahabol na oras.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Mr. President, yung ibang mga proyekto kasi,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: pwede siyang, you know, for this year, marami kang pondo for a certain project.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: For next year, pwedeng wala muna kung may problema ka sa fiscal space.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Pero pagating, Mr. President, sa mga direct na nabibigay natin,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: scholarships, feeding, hindi ho pwedeng one year meron, next year wala.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: That's the position of the committee.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: If we are providing support for X million children on this year,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: With our college kids, it's the same.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kung meron tayong scholarship na binibigay, di naman pwedeng next year wala na yung scholarship.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: In the case of the children, pag wala ng pagkain, magiging malnourished na sila.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So if we are funding programs and we intend to really bring this up to DBM at some point,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: kung pinupondohan na natin yung isang programa, dapat tuloy-tuloy yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Now, I understand, may building, may nagawang, ano ba, building or whatever this year,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Huwag muna, kasi kulan ng pondo.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Pero pagating sa direct na tulong sa mga bata, direct na tulong sa mga estudyante,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And that's incumbent upon us, kasi tayo po yung nagpupondo eh.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Ang congressman at senador ang nagpupondo.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We have the power of the purse.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So it's incumbent upon us na kung merong programang nasimulan, kailangan tuloy-tuloy.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Can you imagine kung yung four-piece, may programa ka for X years,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: tapos every year, hindi ka sigurado kung makakakuha ka.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Or kung magsasaka ka, tapos meron kang tulong sa pataba ngayon,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: next season, wala ka ng tulong, natanggal ka sa listahan, hindi naman pwede yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, Mr. President, the feeding program, the scholarships, kapag nabigay na,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And this is something I think that we can all work towards.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Thankfully, the Senate President has given a solution to the scholarships.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And kapag panahon na po ni Senator Joel defending the test budget,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: ako naman yung maglalabas ng mga frustrations ko.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We've found some solutions for the scholarships.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, at least yung scholarships, pwede ho nating sabihin, pwedeng tuloy-tuloy.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Although, TESDA, we're still looking for solutions for TESDA.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Ito pong feeding program, sana pong magkaisa tayo to support this.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Next will be Senator Robin Padilla.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Magandang gabi, Senator Padilla, at maligayang kaarawan.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Maraming salamat po sa ating ginawong sponsor.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ako po meron lang mga konting katanungan para po sa ating ginawong sponsor.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Una po, kanina po ako yung nakikiayon po sa inyo at napakaganda po ng inyong ginawang talumpati patungkol po sa feeding program.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kasi yan po ay talagang naiintindihan po natin dahil noong 2007 po,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: nagtayo po tayo ng isang paaralan para sa elementarya.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ito po yung liwanag ng kapayapaan na foundation school.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Iyan po, sagot namin yung pagkain nila.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Lahat po, uniforme, lahat po yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Sinagot po yan ng aming foundation.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ngunit sa kasamaang palad po, ito po ay naisara.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: protesta ng aming mga kapitbahay na illegal daw po yung aming paaralan

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: at hindi po kami nasuportahan din noong panahon na yun ng DepEd.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kaya nasara po yung paaralan na yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Pero ako po ay naliligayahan at kayo po ay tumindig dyan at kayo yung pinaglalaban po ninyo

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: na dapat yung mga ganitong programa ay dapat supportahan,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: hindi lamang ng gobyerno kundi lahat ng pamayanang Pilipino,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: na nakakaintindi na kailangan na kailangan ng paaralan ng ating mga puslit na mga kabataan.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Yung pagkain, mahirap pumasok sa paaralan ng gutom.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ngayon po, ang tanong ko po,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: doon po ba sa feeding ay maingat po tayo para po doon sa mga estudyante din na Muslim?

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Alam nyo naman po na bawal sa amin ang buboy.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Mr. President, the procurement ng feeding program po ay nasa division level.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, the secretaries here, alam naman po ng division na ano po yung sensitivities.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, there are also guidelines to also take care of our Muslim children, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Opo, napakalaking bagay po kung magiging sensitivities.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: So, alam ko naman po yung ating si Kuya.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Makikikuya na po ako kay Sen. Anggara dahil isa po yan sa...

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Yung ating kalihim na dating Sen. Isa po yan sa naging Kuya ko dito, nung bago po ako dito.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Alam nyo po, pumasa po dito, ginawang sponsor yung Shik Karimul Macdom Day.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: At siya po ang sponsor niyan.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: po ang author din yan, naniniwala

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: the guidelines will be sensitive towards our

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Gusto ko lamang po, kasi kanina napag-usapan po

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: sa opisina ng mga tao po

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: ng ating mahal na kalihim, pero gusto ko rin

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: po dito. Kami po yung napaliwanagan eh.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Pero mas maganda po ngayon, meron

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: sa madrasa. Kung ito po'y tuloy-tuloy ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kalihim. Last na lang po ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: po kami ng DepEd dito sa

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: ang DepEd din po para next year

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Isa pong malaking hakbang po ito

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: para sa kapayapaan. Dahil alam naman po

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: natin. Dahil ang ating pong mahalan,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: na kalihim ang otor nito eh.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: na malaman ng ating mga kababayan

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: edad ng mga kabataan natin. Sa murang

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: edad, maintindihan na po nila na

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: religion na matagal na dito po sa Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: MOOE funds to help in the

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: As well as a big celebration

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ibig pong sabihin, pati po yung katulad po sa

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Nagpayong, hindi naman po silang Muslim school.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ibig sabihin, lahat po, national level.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Lako, maraming salamat po. Mabuhay po kayo.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Salam alaikum. Maraming salamat, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Mr. President, while we're waiting for two more colleagues,

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: maybe I can just interject, just a manifestation of support.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Mr. President, thank you to Senator Bam and Senator, of course, Senator Sunny Angara, our Secretary.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: A lot of questions were asked today about education.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: hindi po napondohan yung classrooms for this year

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: dahil hindi po na-implement completely yung pondo for 2026.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Now, maganda po, ongoing po ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Seven months of the year, of this year,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: kung merong mga problema sa titulo,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: kung ano talaga yung kailangan ng mga particular schools.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And now that that data is ready,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: and in fact, they gave us the data yesterday,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: magiging mas mabilis na rin po yung implementation.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Now, with regard to the gap, Mr. President,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: hindi po ito matatapos ng isang presidente.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: and this is the fourth of projects.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Because ganun po kalaki ang gap natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Pero even if we do 10,000 a year,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: In fact, we're gonna try to do 20,000 next year.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: seven to eight to nine years po yan,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: bago po natin maabot yung gap.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, the implementation and the funding need to continue.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Pero at the end of the day, Mr. President,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, kung handa tayong pondohan yan,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Now, yung isa rin plano ng DepEd is also the PPP.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: 10 gives dun po sa mga contractor

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Unfortunately, hindi po siya natuloy this year.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Sinisikap po nila na matuloy yan next year or next-next year.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: it will be another modality ng pagpapatuyo po ng classroom.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: maybe up to 20,000 to 30,000 classrooms or even more

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: can be done through the Public-Private Partnerships.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Naalala ko po, Mr. Sponsor, Sen. Bam, na

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: it was you who first raised this concern na

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: ilang classroom lang po yung napatayo nila?

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: So out of 140,000 classroom na shortage.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So by the end of the year, 48.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Okay, so by the end of 2025,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Although at the time of the hearing,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: 22 pa lang po yung natapos na.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: It was already August, I think, or September.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: So for this year, ano po ang target?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: The target for this year is 19,000.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And ang mangyayari po, tutuloy po siya till next year.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kasi hindi po talaga na-delay na mga six months, honestly, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Yung implementation, about six to eight months.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Naka-identify na yung mga classrooms na ito,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And EDCOM 2 will be publishing this data very soon.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But admittedly, nasa MOA stage yung iba.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Nasa first stage pa lang yung iba.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And the target is to have this finished by middle of next year.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So I'm hearing from the Secretary that a construction period for any infra is two years.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So if you look at it from that perspective, next year pa talaga.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But as you and I both know, we had high hopes that a number of this would have been completed.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But they still have space for next year to finish the targeted 18,000 to 19,000.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: So ano ang problema talaga yung funding or yung kakayahan to construct or the processes na napakatagal po?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Ako, if you ask me, and this is the subject of our hearings multiple times,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: DepEd took about six months to really assess every site and validate.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Shouldn't you have that data ready already?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But they validated again all of the sites.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And may data na po sila.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Yung mga skwelahan, may problema ba sa titulo?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And of course, we can argue whether that was the sound methodology or not.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: the start of many of these school buildings were delayed

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: because they took the due diligence to really check every site first.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: the pangako naman nila is that ngayon na na-test na yan at alam na yan,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: mas mabilis na dapat yung implementation.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Since nabanggit mo nga kanina na it will take about nine to ten years.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: So ibig sabihin yung studyante na grade one,

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: maaaring hindi na niya mapakinabangan yung classroom kasi baka nakagraduate na siya bago matapos.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Well, Mr. President, ang priority natin is actually the lower years, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So si kinder tsaka si grade one, yun talaga yung priority.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Yung GAIDA is also a priority.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We passed the GAIDA law recently at nasa budget rin in the BFF, yung GAIDA schools.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So hopefully, Mr. President, yung mga maliliit na bata,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: nasa malalayong lugar ang mabibigyan ng suporta kaagad.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: The truth is, Mr. President, mas ang nahihirapan talaga tayo yung mga heavily congested schools

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: because there's no more land, wala na pong lupa.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And in those areas, kailangan mo ng seven to ten floors na dihamak mas mahal kesa yung mga one to three floors.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Mas matagal rin siyang i-construct kasi kailangan mo na ng elevator at may demolition.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So in many of the congested areas, it's a little bit, may konting difficulty.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: In the areas na nasa malalayong lugar, gaya po na nabanggitin niyo, actually, technically, mas madali siyang gawan kasi mas simple.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But in any case, Mr. President, our committee nakabantay po dito.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: In fact, sometimes I feel that they also think masyado na akong makulit.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Pero we're doing our best, Mr. President, to make sure na on track ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And our next goal is to publish.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: The 2026 rollout and the 2027 rollout as well, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Pakisilip lang po sa mga gaida areas.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Mas marami pong lupa doon kesa classroom.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: So nasa opposite situation naman po yung mga nasa gaida.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ako mismo po, Mr. President, Mr. Sponsor, napuntahan ko talaga to.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Even just last week, nakita ko yung sitwasyon.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sa bundok o sa pinakamalayong mga probinsya.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Kasi ako mismo, napuntahan ko na po yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Kung narinig natin si Senate President Pro Tempore yun sa Itbulaga.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Mas malayo yung Santa Ana, Batanes.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Mas dulo pa kesa dito sa Apare.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ako mismo, napuntahan ko na yung Apare, Santa Ana, Batanes.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At dito naman po sa Mindanao.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Lalo sa amin, mga taga Mindanao.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Batanggenyo po ako na taga Mindanao.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Makikita mo yung mga estudyante naglalakad.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sabi nila, nagsisharing lang sila sa classroom.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Yun naman ang gagamit yung ibang mga school.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Mamaya ibang grade level naman ang gagamit.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Malaking tulong rin po yung feeding program nyo, Mr. Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sana ma-address natin itong shortage ng classroom.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Kasi hindi na po makakaantay yung ating mga estudyante.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Kahit na ginawa nyo ng K-12 nga.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Bakit hindi na nila mapapakinabangan itong mga classrooms na ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Until we can finally fill in the gaps dito sa shortage.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At how does the department prioritize schools and localities for classroom construction?

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Particularly in areas experiencing severe classroom shortage.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Mr. President, the priority is severe classroom shortage, congestion, unsafe classrooms, gaida, or last mile schools, and high enrollment.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And then of course, once may listahan na po yan, the projects will be screened further for readiness.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Ibig sabihin may buildable space, may titulo, and technically feasible to build there.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And then DepEd will also decide kung ito ba'y mapupunta sa LGU, sa mga...

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Although wala pa naman yung CSO-NGO, but we did provide it in the GAAA for 2026.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Or even if it will be built by DepEd, which are the learning continuity spaces.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: By February, magsisimula na yung constructing for most of these.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Practically all magsisimula na daw po by February for the CSO and NGOs.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So yun po yung criteria natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Napansin ko po, may mga eskwelahan pa rin na hindi maganda yung kondisyon, sira-sira yung bubong, o ang iero pa rin ang bubong.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Hindi maayos ang mga silid-aralan, maruruming palikuran, kahoy na pundasyon, at marami pang iba.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Parati pong hinain ng mga teachers na sana po'y matutukan ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At sa sino po among our DepEd officials?

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: I'm sure yung mga RD na napuntahan nila.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Who among the top DepEd officials na mismong nasaksihan o nakita nila yung real situation on the ground?

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Who's assigned to the school buildings ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So Mr. President, yung leadership ng DepEd, may mga assigned regions sila.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So apart from their duties at Central, umiikot rin po sila sa mga region.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So all of the leadership from the Secretary, USEC, ASEC,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: umiikot po sila sa mga iba't ibang lugar.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Napuntahan rin nila yung, nagkocross lang sa river with?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Si SEC daw po mismo ang nakadaan po doon.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sa labas. Two hours from. Sa labas na.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Two hours from the borderline po ng Del Norte at Del Sur.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: So kaminado naman ang ating Secretary.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: o ang departamento na talagang mahirap ang sitwasyon doon sa malalayong lugar,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Doon na po natutulog yung mga teacher.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: If you remember, sa guide-a-law, hindi lang po siya pagtayo ng classroom sa malalayong lugar.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We even included allowances for the teacher or even building dorms for them

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: and setting up the site maps na lahat ng mga malalayong lugar.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Every three kilometers, dapat merong skwilahan sa mga barangay o sa mga individual.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, we're hoping for the full implementation of this law, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And of course, DepEd supported that law, kaya umaasa po kami ma-implement po siya this year.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sana po ang aking pangarap, dream ko po na sana the soonest possible time na ma-address po ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Hindi naman natin totally kaagad immediately sa tatlong taon.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: But sana po yung magkaroon ng maayos at komportable naman pong silid para lang ang ating mga estudyante.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Dahil sila po yung kinabukasan ng ating bayan, ito mga kabataan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Lalo-lalo na po yung mga mahirap nating mga kabataan na gusto pong mag-aral at wala pong kakayahang mag-aral sa mga private schools.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Mr. President, another important concern that we must address is the safety and security of our learners inside our public schools.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Alam naman natin na marami pong shooting incidents na nangyari.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Following the recent incidents of violence in our educational institutions, we must ensure that our schools are adequately equipped and prepared to prevent, detect, and respond to potential security threats.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Nabalita naman natin sa South Cotabato, sa Banga, sa Tacloban, at sa Sambuanga.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ang nababalitaan natin, nakakalungkot po, habang hindi pa po batas ang Senate Bill 2427 o ito pong Comprehensive School Safety Act na ipinasa dito sa Senado ng sponsor at inyakda ko rin po.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ano po ba ang plano ng DepEd sa ngayon to improve the security sa ating mga paralan?

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Does DepEd have a framework for this, prioritization framework?

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Which schools have received security upgrades first?

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Dahil tuwing narinig natin may mga incidenteng ganito, maraming turuan na, kulang sa security, kulang sa ganito, kulang sa CCTV.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ano ba ang ginagawa ng DepEd sa ngayon para ma-address na po ito?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Mr. President, unang-una, they have done a 100% school safety audit.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, naaral po lahat ng mga eskwelahan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And now, they will prioritize the deployment of additional security personnel.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: In large, extra large, and mega schools.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Ito po yung mga eskwelahan na libu-libu yung mga bata.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Meron na po silang Joint Circular with DILG for deployment of barangay tanod to smaller schools.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: At meron na rin pong pagpayag na paggamit ng MOE to provide CCTV, metal detectors.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And ang ibang LGU po tumulong rin sa mga safety infrastructure.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kasama rin po dito yung training programs para sa mga teachers, student leaders,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: sa magulang, dun po sa tamang paggamit ng internet.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: In the audit, lumalabas po na 44% of schools have CCTV, while the rest of course wala po.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Meron rin pong may mga metal detector, about 47%.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And then 75% may fences, and may pondo rin po ngayon sa budget for perimeter fencing.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Yung security guard, watchmen, and the rest, meron rin po silang pag-aaral.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: At kasama na po dito yung dagdag na pondo at yung pagpayag sa mga tanod na tumulong rin.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And so on and so forth, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, they have been doing their jobs, but as we find in the School Safety Act,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: nilang po ito paramihan ng kagamitan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kailangan po talaga ng tamang pag-iintindi ng mga magulang, studyante, guro,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: kung paano talaga maiwasan ang masasamang elemento para hindi po tayo humantong sa karahasan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: It's a big challenge, pero naniniwala po tayo na gaya ng nakalagay sa School Safety Act,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: kung magsasama-sama yung komunidad, merong support for equipment,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: may tamang kaalaman pagating sa paggamit ng internet,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: mas magkakaroon po tayo ng mga skwilahan na mas ligtas.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, we are, ano naman, they are doing what they can,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: but as you have said, Mr. President, kapag napasa yung batas,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: mas magkakaroon ng lakas para ma-implement yung school safety sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Mr. Sponsor, dito naman tayo sa teachers' welfare on another topic.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Mr. President, I would like to raise a matter concerning the welfare and financial security of our public school teachers.

segments.text: What options are available for workers who need to move outside BPO?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Mr. President, let me share, in that hearing that we had, meron kaming nakausap na may-ari ng isang maliit na call center sa Cebu.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Only 150 seats, 200 seats. And when I visited her, their call center agents were training the AI that will eventually replace them.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Can you imagine that? Yung trabaho po nila…

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: No, but somebody needs to do it.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Because naghahalusinate nga yung AI hanggang ngayon.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: They're basically working on their obsolescence, no? Yung call center na ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: When I asked her, ano yung plano niya, ang sagot niya sa akin, catering. Like, mag-iiba talaga siya ng industriya.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And when I saw her again a few months later, caterer na siya.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, there's really a lot of risk here, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And alongside yourself, I've been trying to really…

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kung bagay yung sa Tagalog, kinakalampag ho natin na we need to be able to really do more in terms of those who…

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: who might lose their jobs. Ang takot ko po dito…

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: It's a huge number, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We're talking of upwards of a million.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Na ma-dislocate. Napakarami niyan. Hindi naman pwede mag-cater.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Napakarami as a whole. But if you look at it, Mr. President, per city.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kasi nagkaroon tayo ng next wave cities implementation.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kaya nga, yung breakdown per city.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Pag bin-breakdown niyo po yun per city, kahit isang call center sa isang syudad magsara,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: 1,000 ka agad yan na mawawala ng trabaho.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Tapos times five. Kasi yung kada pamilya.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Yung mga kumikita dyan because of the eateries, because of transportation.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, this is something we really have to look at, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And honestly, maganda pong na-bring up niyo ito because I honestly feel that

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: the executive really needs to focus on this a little bit more.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: It's not really with DTI per se, but definitely, kung meron pong industriya na magkakaproblema,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: From the Secretary, provides market access for MSMEs, supply exporters, but in terms of this…

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: I think we have to provide a little more than market access.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Surely, there should be an industry roadmap for BPO.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: A little more than market access is required.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: And I think that's within DTI's mandate.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Yes, and let me add, during the time that roadmap was being made,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I don't think the level of advancement of AI was considered…

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: By roadmap, I mean a new one.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Hindi na pwede talaga yun dati.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Okay, I get that, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: The BOI, ba, is in charge of that?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, Yusek Perio is a regular guest here already in the Senate.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: He's nodding his head that they will take a look at that.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Parang wala pa tayong nakikita ng AI roadmap.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But I'm afraid that it might not be up to par with the advancements.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Last year, hawak ko yung budget ng DTI.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: lahat nagulat na yung DTI pala ang regulatory agency

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: para sa lahat ng kontratista ng Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Ito yung number nung contracting industry.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: This is the PCAB, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: The PCAB has a CIAP on top of it,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: which is a regulatory including DTI.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: The PCAB is now complete, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: And yung CIAP, kompleto na rin.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Meron na ba tayong rules to verify that the contractor has enough working capital,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: There is stricter implementation now, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: This is coming from the Secretary.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Under implementation, paano mag-iimplement nung nakaraan taon,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: wala pa ngang IRR na bago.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: but as many times as we requested them to submit the revised rules,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: So, I don't know what they're implementing kasi hindi pwede yung lumang rules.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Mr. President, may clarify, wala hong nabigay ang CIAP o walang nabigay ang DTI?

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: DTI in general was supposed to give that kasi nga it became very, very controversial

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: na yung mga blacklisted, pinapayagan pa rin.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Yung mga walang puhunan, walang equipment, andun pa rin.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Tapos, yung mga contractors dealing with so many public works contracts,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Who checks the equipment, the plant, and the personnel?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, according to the Secretary, Mr. President,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: They'll submit the rules, but right now,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: The rules are still the same or they've been revised finally?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: They're revised, and right now, nagtanggal na sila ng conflict of interest.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, right now, contractors are no longer allowed to sit in the PCAB.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: And what action does the PCAB take if a contractor misrepresents its resources

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: or no longer meets its license requirements?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, they're not given the license if they don't meet the requirements, Mr. President?

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Yun nga, but somewhere along the line.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Diba, uso yan yung naghihiraman ng lisensya.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Usong-uso yan sa flood control, diba?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: From the time that the PCAB was put under the office of the Secretary,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: No, it's always been under DTI.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Siguro, to put it in other words, when the scandal broke out,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: and now that the Secretary's really on top of it,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: she's been very focused on the implementation of these new rules, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: I'm a little perplexed that the implementation came ahead of the revision of the rules,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: If we could see the new rules, because the previous ones were clearly inadequate

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: because they got away with murder.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: There are rules that were agreed on, and they will submit to your office, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: I think they should submit to the body because we are supposed to undertake investigations

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: and we're incapable of doing so until we know what rules are being violated.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Okay, so we were all agitated by the 100% import declared by President Donald Trump in the White House Conference following his visit to ASEAN and APEC. 100% of the Philippines' energy and agricultural imports were derived from the United States. The DFA said that it has since been assigned to the DTI.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: So, Secretary Roque, what is this deal that has been concluded?

segments.text: What commitments, if any, has Manila made on purchase volumes,

segments.text: the exclusive sourcing that was declared, and what is the impact on the tariff?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, Mr. President, the Secretary has informed me that negotiations are ongoing.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And they don't want to divulge the ongoing negotiations.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Well, President Trump has already divulged.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But I myself will say, Mr. President, maybe the Secretary is undergoing negotiations.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I don't think that's even feasible.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I don't think that's even feasible.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But right now, the Secretary is saying negotiations are ongoing.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But, Mr. President, it is the role of the Senate to also find out what this is.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: That's why I've actually filed a resolution, which is why I'm taking the opportunity to ask.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: If it gets sent to my committee,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: we can take a look at that, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kung sa trade siya pupunta, we can have a hearing about that para we can ask the Secretary and the other agencies

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: to share with us where they are in terms of negotiations.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Because in the end, all of these negotiations will be a treaty, and we will also have to sign off on it anyway.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, we might as well find out from now.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But, honestly, Mr. President, nung nalaman ko yan,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: pero nung nalaman ko yan, Mr. President, ang una kong tanong,

segments.text: I don't think it's even really possible to have all of your employees,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Pero tama ka, Mr. President, maganda nga na malaman na rin ng Senado ano ba yung parameters nito.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: In the realm of the possible, there was a proposed reduction of the 12.5 tariffs to 10%.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Also part of the negotiations, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Naku, sa ginastos natin na bilyon-bilyon, walang sigurado?

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Hindi pala sulit yung ating gastos, pambira.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: O, sige, last question na lang.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Magkano ang noche buena sa taong ito?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Mr. President, wala pa silang number kasi kausap pa lang nila yung mga manufacturers,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: but they commit to send to you.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I'm also interested to find out magkano ba yung bilang na yun.

segments.text: Kasi katakot-takot na mura upa ka.

segments.text: Then, Mr. President, we will look at the list.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: They will come out with the list of noche buena prices.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: They will come out with the noche buena list by first week of December?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: By the end of the month.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And then we can all look at it together, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Thank you. Thank you, Senator Marcos.

segments.text: But some of that will be

segments.text: and then a part of that will be the design

segments.text: So, the first will be in

segments.text: lumalalim na rin po ang gabi. Maga

segments.text: alas dosi na. Marami pa po kaming tanong
