segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Good evening again to the chairman

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: and good evening to the secretary and the

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Yes. Kasi ako na yung agency na kasunod.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And it's the same topic I raised last year.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And it's the same topic I raised

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, last year, Mr. Chairman, I had asked the Secretary on the status of the regulations of the e-cigarettes.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Because the history of this is that, by law, a law that I opposed, the power to regulate the use, the putting on the market of e-cigarettes and vapes was large in DTI.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: I objected to that because DTI, as far as I know, has never had the power and the capacity to look into the health of human beings.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, if I recall correctly, and the Secretary can clarify that statement, but if I recall correctly, on the statement, she basically agreed with me that they don't have that capacity.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And the commitment was that they would be coordinating with DOH, FDA in particular, because FDA is the Food and Drug Authority Administration that has that power.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: There is a requirement for certain types of equipment, and they do not have that equipment.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: For Pangatlo na yata ang Secretary, si Secretary ngayon, na umaamin naman na wala naman silang equipment na gano'n.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, this time, I was happy kasi Secretary said they will be coordinating with DOH on the testing of the e-liquids.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Kasi, like every Secretary before her, ang kaya lang nila i-test is yung gadget.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Pero yung laman ng liquid, now we have so many reports that says that maraming nagbibigay ng sakit sa mga...

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: sa mga gumagamit nun, maraming carcinogens involved, maraming substances that are not even declared, maraming kombinasyon na masama pa lang i-combine, walang capacity si dito ay doon.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, that's just the update I want, what kind of coordination has happened.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: What companies here can go to these laboratories?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And they get the FDA after that?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: No, sir. For the FDA, pag nila ng medicine or therapy.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So far, since no companies have been...

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, you will accept the results of this?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Okay. Mr. President, so, there are now three testing laboratories that the DTI has recognized.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: The first is the BPS testing laboratory in Dasmarinas, Cavite for the device and the battery.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: There is a La Primera Testing Center Corp. in Quezon City for the liquid and the consumable.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And then, another one based in China, the Shenzhen Element Testing Company Limited in Shenzhen, China, for the device, the battery, the e-liquid, and the consumable.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, you're concerned, Mr. President, about the e-liquid and consumable.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: There are two testing laboratories currently, and my understanding from DTI is that they will accept the results of these laboratories.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, yun po, Mr. President, ang update po dito.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, Mr. President, I've been informed, and please don't shoot the messenger here.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Nito po siya sa likod, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: They're tested by these laboratories, and then kapag pumasa, they're allowed to transact.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And they're testing for safety, human safety.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, according to the standards of the Tobacco Laboratory Network, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, they're tested based on the standards of the Tobacco Laboratory Network.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Matatawa si Senator Aimee at the record show.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: That network has been identified by DOH as the gold standard for testing for these types of products.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: The name sounds suspicious, so I'm sorry for that remark.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: But please know that I have been standing here for years listening to the most ridiculous answers.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, pagpasensahan nyo na if I have so much doubts.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And I will now raise my concern.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Diba nabanggit nyo yung isang laboratory sa China?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: The Shenzhen Element Testing Company Limited in Shenzhen.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: I hate to have to ask you this, Mr. Chairman, because the person who should be answering this is the subcommittee chair for Department of Health.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: But since by law, we gave it to DTI, the DTI will have to give their best answer to his honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Is China the gold standard for healthcare when it comes to their...

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, Mr. President, and again, this is according to our friends from DTI, these laboratories test based on the global standard.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, kung ang tanong po ay standard, iisa lang naman daw po yung standard sa mundo.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Now, if the question is, do these laboratories test it well or not?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But the standard itself is set as a global standard.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And China is also the source of contaminated milk products, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And not that it doesn't happen all over the world.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Di ko ako galit sa China, to be clear.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Baka may ibang galit ako, di ko ako galit sa China.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: You can ask any FDA official, and they will tell you that the gold standards are...

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: The US, some of the European countries, Japan...

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: May I inquire, Mr. President, why these are the laboratories?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: If you can give me a second.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: These are the only three in the world.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, the products here are usually tested globally.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, Mr. President, if I may share the history of this.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, initially, we didn't have any testing centers here.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: The last update I had, wala.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, what the companies would use is this Shenzhen element testing.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But now that there are two centers here, most of the products are actually tested locally

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: in the centers in Cavite and Quezon.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Who is it who's giving us the response, Mr. Chairman?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: This is Asec Valdez, who is the Asec in charge of tobacco?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, he is the Asec in charge of vape, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: How long has he been with DTI and in charge of vapes?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Kaya ako lang tinatanong kasi I'm not sure if Secretary was already the Secretary when

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And I already raised this issue of gold standard.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Kung gusto talaga ng gold standard, may ibang gold standard.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Uulitin ko, and I'm sure, Secretary, you've heard me say this, that in the FBA,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: before I get that, because I'm having them check the number,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: sabi nyo, there are now two testing facilities.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Technically, there's only one, because the two that you mentioned,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: one is on the gadget, not on the liquid.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, isa lang yung sa liquid.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: La Primera Testing Center in Quezon City.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Pero sabi nyo naman, this is approved by Tobacco Lab Network

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: that I have no personal knowledge of.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: But, sure tayo dyan, kasi tatanungin ko sa DOH yan bukas.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: O kung kailan man si DOH.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, during the Blue Ribbon hearing that you led, Senator Pia,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: DOH said that we have to follow the TOB.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And then, from there, the Shenzhen was the first,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: and then itong La Primera are accredited by DTI.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, to be clear, it's DTI that accredits these laboratories,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: because these are the laboratories that can check based on the TOB LabNet standards.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, I will just counter-check that with DOH,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: but thank you for the explanation.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And as long as we will...

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Because I have a difficulty holding you accountable for a task

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: that you have no, absolutely no training on.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Like, if I ask you na, ano yung standards na yun, sir,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Wala ka namang science background, o meron naman po?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, normally, when I talk to the FDA,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: doktor yun, or public health expert.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, you understand why, if I had to interrogate you as a witness,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: I will have a hard time recognizing you as an expert witness

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: when it comes to the safety of e-cigarettes and ano.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Do you understand my difficulty in attributing,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: accepting that may expertise ang DTI?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: In terms of testing, they are not experts, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: I have to go through because I have to call DOH and FDI to make sure

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: because how can you account for it?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Even the chairman agrees with me.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, no judgment on anything else except your lack of expertise in this area.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: If I tell you na when you go to that facility, what are you looking for?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Do you know what to look for, Mr. Valdez?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: What kind of equipment you're looking for?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: How to know if that equipment,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: meron pong list of tests and machines that they counter-check with these centers.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, it's the same way that you and I, Mr. Chairman, will do that.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: I don't know how hard it is to elicit that admission.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: They're not health experts, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: But they seem to have a hard time accepting that.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: For you, Mr. Chairman, without batting an eye, you say it.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Mr. President, if I may add to this discussion,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: although I'm not sure if I should,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: but I think what we need to clarify talaga is

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: they're treating vape like any other product, I think.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And the way that you see it, and I agree with you,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: is that there are health implications to this product.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And kayo din naman po yung…

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: There are reports all over the world of, honestly, youth

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: that are having problems with vape.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kunyari, kasi kung gamot yan, FDA yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kapag mga gadgets yan, DTI yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Yung hindi man lang pinapahid, yung pabangong ganyan, FDA.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: If you ingest it, it should be with FDA

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: and not just, you know, other…

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, I agree with you there, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But, again, DTI naman, na-assign ito sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Hindi naman nila choice rin ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Yes, and I've been very patiently recognizing

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: that they did not ask for it.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Pero, I just wanted sana, an admission na

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: pero may batas na sinabing gawin namin ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Yun lang naman yung gusto ko marinig.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Kasi, magpipilit ba kayong may science background kayo?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Kayo po ba ay may mga experts na pharmacologists?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Kayo ba ay may mga pediatric specialists?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, they have at best chemical engineers,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Mr. President, I will break protocol

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: because I'm also interested in this topic.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: If I have the answer, I will share.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Tobacco products, is it with FDA or with DTI?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: That's a very long history, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: I was the author of the law

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: the existing food and drug law.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And there's a provision there that tobacco products should be governed by FDA,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And the tobacco companies brought it to court.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Sorry, the specific provision is, sorry, ang tagal na nito.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Anything that, to the effect that anything that affects health

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And the tobacco companies lobbied that it does not affect health.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: In the Philippines or in the Philippines?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And the lower court agreed with the, if I remember my history correctly, okay.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And a few years ago, the Supreme Court ruled that no, it is the FDA

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And then nag-motion for reconsideration po yan, antay na naman tayo.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Then with finality, the Supreme Court ruled that tobacco affects health.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And so, ang Toblabnet, hindi ba ano po yan, Mr. President,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: if this is the tobacco standard, then shouldn't it be with FDA as well?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Yes, so I'm waiting for, I don't want to amend the law tapos ma-vivido lang.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, but I'm happy to, I mean, I have bills pending.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Anyway, let's not belabor the point.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: I think I've made my point.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: I will do my own checking with FDA.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: But just for the record, and again, sorry, paulit-ulit lang ako.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: But I need people to know that in the U.S., at the time, I was opposing that bill that is now the law that gave DTI the power to regulate the safety of the liquid that is being inhaled by 10-year-olds now.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And I will repeat the figures I gave you earlier.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: For the sake of the DTI family, that from 3% usage of 10-19 years old in 2015, it is now 39% as of 2023.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Because it just went up tremendously.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Because I also checked with my staff.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Medyo mahirap na siyang hanapin dun sa mga Shopee.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And I have to thank you, Secretary, because I believe that you continue.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: I knew some of the work of your predecessors, but when I brought it to your attention, medyo na ano niyan.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: But what I want to point out is this.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: When I was opposing this law five years ago or so, I pointed out that the FDA in the U.S.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: That also has its share of lobbying, ha?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: The U.S. is really known to be also a strong oil lobby country, tobacco lobby country.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: But despite that, the FDA had rejected.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: 55,000 flavors were rejected by the FDA because they failed to prove that it had any health benefit.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And on the contrary, nakakasama pa.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano

segments.text: I know, because during the hearing, nagbigay sila ng numero.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But if you remember, in our hearing, it was closer to...

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And honestly, Mr. President, latest reports have it higher to about 1,000.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, it would be good, Mr. President, if maybe an independent agency like DSWD or NCIP could help us with identifying who are the possible families who will be affected.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Because we want to make sure that...

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We want to make sure that if this initiative does push through, wala pong kababayan na masasagasaan o mapeperwisyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: I'm sure you've heard, as well as Senator Padilla and myself, from the IPs, as well as the residents, those in Tarlac and elsewhere,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: who are very, very concerned because they've really received notices to vacate and the request to sign quit claims and waivers.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Determined the total amount necessary to compensate these people who will be affected in the loss of their homes, their agricultural land, their livelihood, their crops?

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Meron na kayong estimate kung magkano ang kakailanganin?

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: So, has anybody been given quit claims or anything?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Mr. President, for the record, BCDA is saying that they're still currently talking...

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: To the affected individuals in our hearing, and this is, of course, before Mr. Nepomuceno's time.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We also enjoined the President then not to do press releases without informing the local leaders first.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Because even the mayor of Capas found out about this initiative on the news.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Yes, not even... Nobody really talked to him.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But, Mr. President, for the record, wala naman daw pong pinapapirmang quit claim.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And it would be good if...

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: If we can have another hearing and we have evidence to this that any quick claims were provided to any of the families there.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Are there any identified potential relocation sites for the affected families?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But, Mr. President, may I also remind everyone that this area is three times the size of BGC.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, whether these are 300, 500, or 1,000 families...

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Surely, there needs to be buy-in, there needs to be consent, and there needs to be a good area for them, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Or even to carve out their area.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Because the area is so huge.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: You need to derive informed consent, there's cost to develop these areas, to provide them with adequate housing, basic utilities, livelihood opportunities, and so on.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: I also don't know how you can compensate the burial grounds and the ancestors of some of our [unclear].

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: That was brought up in the hearing.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I suggested we have a burial ground in the middle of this area.
